page: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v7 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor running up to 4.2 GHz, provisioned with 10 physical cores supporting hyper-threading across 20 dedicated vCPUs. The architecture features an extensive 480 MB L3 cache, complemented by 2 MB of L2 cache and 48 KB of L1d cache per core. Compute capabilities are augmented by hardware instruction sets including AVX-512, AMX (Tile and INT8), and vector AES cryptography instructions.

The instance delivers 160.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage architecture combines Premium Storage capability with a dedicated 1,181 GB local NVMe SSD for high-throughput, low-latency temporary storage. No hardware graphics accelerators are provisioned. Network connectivity does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard Azure network configurations for external ingress.

Benchmark testing demonstrates strong single-threaded processing capabilities, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 1,983.0 and strong compression throughput with 35.47 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip and 14.71 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Multi-core and sustained compute operations sit within the average tier across tested cloud hardware, highlighted by a multi-core stress-ng score of 20,081.26 and a PassMark CPU score of 33,317.5. Memory subsystem throughput reaches 141.96 GB/sec on large-block uncached reads and 58.49 GB/sec on uncached writes, driving 34.81 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations.

From a resource and density perspective, the E20ds_v7 provides a balanced allocation for memory-bound workloads where dedicated vCPUs and direct local NVMe capacity eliminate storage contention. The hardware profile is best matched to in-memory databases, intermediate caching systems, analytics processing, enterprise relational databases, and data transformation pipelines that require substantial working memory alongside fast temporary scratch space.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 20 dedicated vCPUs and 10 physical cores derived from an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 160.0 GB of memory alongside an integrated 1,181 GB local NVMe SSD for fast transient I/O. Hardware support includes AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions, supported by a 480 MB L3 cache. Benchmarks reflect strong single-core compute and data decompression rates, paired with solid memory bandwidth yielding 34.81 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. The lack of integrated GPUs keeps the profile focused on CPU and memory throughput. The server provides a balanced profile for in-memory databases, caching layers, relational database servers, and memory-intensive analytics workloads requiring dependable local disk caching.
